dizidle: dezir + le — tell him (imperative 2nd pl. + enclitic dative le; dizidle al Campeador 'tell the Campeador'; = decidle)
siet: siete — seven (apocopated before a noun; siet sedmanas 'seven weeks'; = siete)
adóbes: adobar + se — that he make himself ready, equip himself (present subjunctive 3rd sg. adobe + reflexive se; adóbes con sos vassallos 'that he get ready with his vassals'; = que se apreste; modern adobar means 'to marinate, repair')
véngam: venir + me — may he come to me (present subjunctive 3rd sg. venga + enclitic me; véngam a Toledo 'let him come to me at Toledo'; = que venga a mí)
éstol: esto + le — this to him (neuter demonstrative esto + enclitic dative le; éstol do de plazdo 'I give him this as a term'; = le doy esto)
saludádmelos: saludar + me + los — greet them for me (imperative 2nd pl. + ethic dative me 'for me' + object los; = saludádmelos)
espaçio: espacio — leisure, time, room (noun; entrellos aya espaçio 'let there be leisure among them'; the exact sense is a little uncertain; = espacio)
abino: avenir — it befell (strong preterite 3rd sg., spelling b for v; desto que les abino 'of what befell them'; = avino, ocurrió; modern avenir survives mainly as avenirse)
suyo: suyo — his (stressed possessive; suyo era el cuydado 'the care was his'; = suyo)
detiene: detener — he holds back, delays (present 3rd sg.; non lo detiene por nada 'nothing holds him back'; = detiene)
portogaleses: portogalés — Portuguese (masc. pl.; a los portogaleses 'to the Portuguese'; = portugueses)
gallizianos: gallizianos — Galicians, men of Galicia (masc. pl.; = gallegos; the modern -zianos form does not exist)
castellanos: castellano — Castilian (masc. pl.; varones castellanos 'Castilian lords'; = castellanos)
fazie: fazer — he was making, was holding (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending; cort fazie 'was holding court'; = hacía)
penssando: pensar — thinking, taking thought (gerund; ir + gerund, lo ivan penssando 'they went on thinking it over'; = pensando)
falliessen: fallir — they might fail (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; non falliessen de lo que el rey avié mandado 'that they should not fail in what the king had ordered'; = faltasen; modern fallar and fallir differ in sense)
quite: quitar — release, set free; leave, give up (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que los quite desta cort 'that he release them from this court'; quite mio reyno 'let him quit my kingdom'; = libere, deje)
darlêdes: dar + le + edes — you will give him (split future, infinitive + enclitic le + ending -edes, circumflex marking the run-together words; darlêdes derecho 'you will give him justice'; = le daréis)
irâ: ir + a — goes/will go to (ira 3rd sg. run together with the preposition a, circumflex marking the join; o no irâ mi cort 'or does not go to my court'; = irá a, vaya a)
garçía: García — a personal name, a count named in the poem (el comde don Garçía; = García)
siemprel: siempre + le — always him (adverb + enclitic dative/object le; mal siemprel buscó 'always sought him ill'; = siempre le)
buscó: buscar — he sought (preterite 3rd sg.; mal buscar 'to seek harm, plot against'; = buscó)
conssejó: conssejar — he advised (preterite 3rd sg.; aqueste conssejó los ifantes 'this man advised the infantes'; = aconsejó)
querien: querer — they wished, intended (imperfect 3rd pl., -ien ending; querien ir 'they were wishing to go'; = querían)
anrric: Anrric — a personal name, a count named in the poem (el comde don Anrric; = Enrique)
remond: Remond — a personal name, a count named in the poem (el comde don Remond; = Ramón, Raimundo)
enperador: enperador — emperor (el buen enperador 'the good emperor'; = emperador)
fróila: Fróila — a personal name, a count named in the poem (el comde don Fróila; = Fruela)
birbón: Birbón — a personal name, a count named in the poem (el comde don Birbón; no modern equivalent)
sabidores: sabidor — one who knows, a learned or experienced man (masc. pl.; otros muchos sabidores 'many other men of knowledge'; = sabedores, archaic)
crespo: crespo — curly(-haired), curly (adjective used as a byname; el Crespo de Grañón 'the Curly one of Grañón'; = crespo)
grañón: Grañón — a place named in the poem (el Crespo de Grañón, the count's byname; = Grañón)
oca: Oca — a place named in the poem (el que Oca mandó 'he who governed Oca'; = Oca)
ansuórez: Ansuórez — patronymic 'son of Ansuor' (Gonçalo Ansuórez, Per Ansuórez; -ez ending 'son of'; = Ansúrez)
allís: allí + se — there (adverb allí + ethic reflexive se; allís açertó 'there he chanced to be'; = allí se)
açertó: açertar — he happened, chanced (to be there) (preterite 3rd sg.; allís açertó 'he happened to be there'; = acertó, a different sense from modern acertar 'to hit, get right')
aduxieron: aduzir — they brought (strong preterite 3rd pl.; grand bando que aduxieron 'a great following that they brought'; = adujeron)
enbair: enbair — to confound, get the better of, deceive (infinitive before the enclitic le; enbair le cuydan 'they mean to get the better of him'; sense a little uncertain; = embaír, archaic in modern Spanish)
èl: él — he (stressed subject pronoun, grave accent marking the editor's reading; èl que en buen ora naçió 'he who was born in a good hour'; = él)
tarda: tardar + se — he is late, lingers (present 3rd sg. with reflexive se; por que se tarda 'because he is late'; = se tarda)
adelantel: adelante + le — ahead, before him (adverb + enclitic le; adelantel enbió 'sent (him) ahead'; = le envió adelante)
besasse: besar — he should kiss (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., in indirect command; que besasse las manos 'that he should kiss the hands'; = besase)
firiós: ferir + se — he threw himself (preterite 3rd sg. + reflexive se; firiós a tierra 'he threw himself to the ground'; = se arrojó, se echó; modern herirse is 'to wound oneself')
biltar: biltar — to abase, humble (infinitive, with se following the auxiliary: biltar se quiere 'he wishes to humble himself'; = humillar(se); modern envilecer is the harsher 'to debase')
duele: doler — it hurts, grieves (present 3rd sg.; a mí duele el coraçón 'my heart grieves'; = duele)
ondre: ondrar + se — may it be honored (present subjunctive 3rd sg., reflexive-passive; que por vos se ondre la cort 'that the court be honored through you'; = se honre)
ámen: ámen — amen, so be it (= amén)
omíllom: omillar + me — I bow, humble myself (present 1st sg. + enclitic me; omíllom a vos 'I bow before you'; = me humillo)
arric: Arric — a personal name, a count named in the poem (variant of Anrric; el comde don Arric; = Enrique)
dueña: dueña — lady, noblewoman (dueña es de pro 'she is a lady of worth'; = dueña, now also 'owner' or 'duenna')
posaré: posar — I shall lodge (future 1st sg.; yo posaré a San Serván 'I shall lodge at San Servando'; = posaré)
serván: Serván — in San Serván, San Servando, a monastery/castle across the Tajo from Toledo (= Servando)
vigilia: vigilia — vigil, night watch of prayer (terné vigilia 'I shall keep vigil'; = vigilia)
santidad: santidad — holiness; a holy place (en essa santidad 'in that holy place'; = santidad)

__broaden__.da: dar — he gives (present 3rd sg.; nin da conssejo padre a fijo 'neither does father give help to son'; = da) · also dar tornada 'to turn back' (tornada da 'he turns back'; = da la vuelta, vuelve)
__broaden__.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place') · also es a + infinitive 'is to be done, must be done' (impersonal; Ya lo vidieron que es a fer 'they saw that it had to be done'; = hay que hacer)
__broaden__.tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth') · also a tierra 'to the ground' (firiós a tierra 'he threw himself to the ground'; = a tierra, al suelo)
__broaden__.velar: velar — the veiling, the nuptial blessing (infinitive used as a noun, el velar; a tod el velar 'through the whole of the veiling'; Pidal 'la ceremonia de las velaciones'; = las velaciones) · also velar — to keep vigil, stay awake (infinitive; sabor a de velar 'he has a mind to keep vigil'; = velar)
__broaden__.nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison) · also nos — stressed 'us' after a preposition (daxadas seredes de nos 'you will be abandoned by us'; sobre nos 'upon us'); stressed repeated subject (mártires seremos nos 'we shall be martyrs') · also nos — each other, reciprocal (saludar nos hemos 'we shall greet each other')
__broaden__.sí: sí — so, thus (optative particle, Latin sic; sí el Criador vos salue 'so may the Creator save you'; = así, no modern use as a particle) · also sí — himself, oneself (reflexive pronoun after a preposition; cada uno por sí 'each on his own account') · also sí — yes, indeed, affirmative (sí fago 'yes, I do'; = sí)
__broaden__.aqueste: aqueste — this (= este) · also aqueste — this man (pronoun; aqueste conssejó los ifantes 'this man advised the infantes'; aqueste fo padre 'this one was the father')
__broaden__.assí: assí — thus, so (= así) · also assí — so greatly, so much (Pidal 'de tal modo, mucho'; assí envergonçó 'was so abashed') · also assí commo 'as soon as' (Assí commo descavalga 'as soon as he dismounts'; = así como, en cuanto) · also assí … commo — 'as … as' (assí parientes commo son 'as kinsmen as they are'; the sense is approximate)
__broaden__.toviesse: tener — he might hold, keep (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; que les toviesse pro 'that he should look after their interests, be of use to them'; the exact force of tener pro is uncertain; = tuviese) · also tenerse por — to hold oneself as, consider oneself (non se toviesse por so vassallo 'he should not hold himself his vassal'; = se tuviese por)
__broaden__.aya: aver — I may have (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = haya) · also aya — he may have (present subjunctive 3rd sg., same form as 1st; de Dios aya su graçia 'may he have God's grace', optative; = haya) · also aya — 'let there be' (impersonal subjunctive of aver; entrellos aya espaçio 'let there be leisure among them'; = haya)
__broaden__.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned') · also fo — went (ir; mañanas fo Minaya 'in the morning Minaya went'); fo de moros 'it came from the Moors' (ser de + noun of origin; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — it was, ser + adjective predicate (Buena fo la de Valençia 'good was the (capture) of Valencia'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — was (the man) of, belonged to (ser de of a vassal; el que de Albar Fáñez fo 'he who was Álvar Fáñez's man'; = fue) · also en estas nuevas fo 'was in on these doings, took part' (ser en 'to be involved in'); fo padre 'was the father' (ser + noun predicate)
